title: Tennis: Eala powers past British wildcard, advances to round 2 in Tokyo
summary: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala marched to the second round of the Toray Pan Pacific Open after cruising past Great Britain's Mika Stojsavljevic, 6-1, 6-2 on Monday afternoon.
